Even we might be able to do a sample presentation before our presentation so that we can find the chance if we are doing everything properly or the time is enough for all group members. Even though students can do a test presentation to solve timing issue, students generally do not take that seriously when compared to a test presentation assigned by instructor.
Although they look like they are clear, term assignment instructions are complex and sometimes vague. Should there be a physical poster? Is this poster be on powerpoint presentations or a separate thing? Course does not tell how to that kind of posters so why do we do that and how do we do that? Does everybody in the group need to use different narrative analysis topic? How many of our close reading texts should be presented? Three or one picked out of that three? Even though instructor mentioned one, nearly everybody presented three. This creates a confusion. Namely, this course should dedicate some of class hours and weeks to making preparations and working on term assignment after finishing lecturing other topics. Generally towards the end of the semester would be better for focusing solely on the term assignment.

Unnecessarily overbearing workload with its new curriculum this semester. It is good to have many assignments since it distributes our grades and gives us chances to increase them, however an obligatory COMD class should not be my main stressor of a whole semester while I do not even study COMD. I understand the need for a professional communication course however the way the curriculum was implemented, pretty much all the time I had to spend in class face-to-face felt useless and as a waste (which has nothing to do with the instructor but with the course itself). I can confidently say that this course did not add anything to my life. Plus, I believe that the workload encourages students to use ChatGPT which only dulls our abilities. 
The worst part were the classes themselves: The instructor pulls up a powerpoint (full of typos and errors despite being a communications course) and does a monologue for 2 hours while we sit there to sign the attendance sheet.
Aside from that, this course completely focuses on group projects so it is vital to find good teammates at the start of the semester. Find responsible people because students are not evaluated individually.
Although I think having a class about communication is good, I don't think such a class like this is necessary at all.

This course would be more appropriate as a first-year course. For third-year students, these professional skills should either have been acquired over the past few years or learned earlier. For those who gained these skills during their first two years, this course offers minimal new information or teachings. For students who reach their third year without basic skills such as teamwork and responsibility, this course comes too late to make a significant impact, if change is even possible. It instead creates significant challenges for those who are responsible. This course should be more rigorous and given in the first year, with stricter standards that don't allow students who cannot manage their own responsibilities to pass.

Ders aslında çok genel ve herkesin öğrenmesi gereken bir ders ancak değerlendirme kriterinin hocaya bu kadar bağlı kalması ve hocanın yazdığım şeyden bile hak etmediğim puanlar vermesi gibi detaylar yüzünden ortalamanızda hak etmediğiniz notlar bulabilirsiniz.
